newsitem.title: BELGIUM: SGB says Suez/Lyonnaise merger never discussed.
newsitem.headline: SGB says Suez/Lyonnaise merger never discussed.

text.p: Belgian holding company Societe Generale de Belgique SA (SGB) said on Wednesday the board of its parent company Cie de Suez never discussed a merger with French utility Lyonnaise des Eaux.
"(A merger) is not a fact...it is a hypothesis...the board of Suez has never discussed this issue so far," SGB chairman Etienne Davignon told a news conference on 1996 results.
"(A merger) is still something maybe God and the Holy Spirit are aware of, but I have been trying to contact on the Internet and I have not had many answers at the moment," he said.
Lyonnaise and Suez have themselves declined to comment on a recent British newspaper report which said they had appointed banks to advise them on the deal.

Analysts believed Suez would need to make changes in its SGB subsidiary to take account of the Belgian authorities' hostility to a takeover of Belgian Tractebel utilities firm, part of the SGB group, by French investors.
